**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Just peppermint leaves, nothing else." | Product fact (ingredients), fine |
| "Cool, clean" | Flavour description, fine |
| "gentle on your stomach after a big meal" | **Unsupported.** This is a digestive health claim, and the brand policy bans health claims of any kind. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association." | Allowlisted, exact wording |

**Other checks**
- **Slop and voice:** no banned words or structures, and the tone is plain and unhurried.
- **Disclosure:** none needed. This is our own product page, not a creator post or affiliate link.
- **Approval:** Sam needs to sign off on the revised copy before it goes live.

**Suggested compliant version**
> Peppermint. Just peppermint leaves, nothing else. Cool, clean and fresh-tasting, lovely after a big meal. Certified organic by the Soil Association.

"Lovely after a big meal" is a serving suggestion rather than a effect on the body. If you'd rather avoid any link to digestion, drop that phrase and end on "Cool, clean and fresh-tasting."
